description: Hand a narrower grant to an agent: a subset of this token's scopes, limits no larger, an expiry no later. Answers a refresh token for the agent, shown once.

for.description: The agent's OpenProfile.md URL, so the app can see who holds it.

grant.description: Which of the principal's grants to delegate from. Defaults to the token's own grant.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes, a subset of the parent's.

name: delegate_grant
title: Delegate Grant
